caption: The drawing depicts a large, rectangular, wooden cabinet composed of two main sections. The upper section features a wardrobe with two tall doors, each with a single rounded wooden knob and vertical rectangular panels set into the doors for detail. The lower section consists of a series of fifteen drawers arranged in three vertical columns, each column containing five drawers of the same size, and each drawer is fitted with a single small round wooden knob. The cabinet is a light to medium honey brown wood color with visible grain and has a simple, straight-edged design, including a slight overhang on the top and base for added dimension. The background is a plain, light cream or tan color, free of any additional objects or decoration.
title: Shaker Cabinet with Drawers
